Extend a PSID variable list to new waves using the crosswalk

Source: R/varlists.r
extendVarsPSID.Rd

extendVarsPSID() reads a long variable list (one row per concept and wave) and appends the rows for waves that are missing from it, taking the variable name of each new wave from the UMich crosswalk. Existing rows are never overwritten or deleted.

Usage

extendVarsPSID(vars, cwf, years = NULL, names = NULL)

Arguments

vars

A long data.frame (or data.table) with columns dataset, year, variable, label and name, as read from the inst/psid-lists/*vars.txt files.

cwf

The crosswalk data.frame (the content of psid.xlsx), with one Y<year> column per wave.

years

Waves to add. The default is every wave in psid_supported_waves() later than max(vars$year) that also has a Y<year> column in cwf.

names

Concepts to extend. The default is the concepts whose latest year equals max(vars$year). Concepts that ended earlier are skipped unless they are listed here.

Value

A list with two components: vars, the old rows (with name trimmed) followed by the newly added rows, and review, a data.frame with columns name, year, variable, anchor_year, anchor_variable and status describing what was done for each requested year.

Details

A concept is "alive" when its latest year equals max(vars$year), so a concept with no variable in the newest wave counts as discontinued on later runs unless it is listed in names. years default to the waves of this package later than max(vars$year) that exist in the crosswalk.

For each concept the function takes its latest row as the anchor and looks up the anchor's variable name in cwf with getNamesPSID. Years that already have a row for that concept are reported as already present and are never overwritten. Years whose crosswalk value is missing are reported as no variable in crosswalk for this year. A concept whose anchor is not in cwf is reported as anchor not found in crosswalk. The review status column also contains added and skipped: discontinued.

Examples

cwf <- data.frame(
  Y2017 = c("v2017a", "v2017b"),
  Y2019 = c("v2019a", "v2019b"),
  Y2021 = c("v2021a", "v2021b"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
vars <- data.frame(
  dataset = "fam",
  year = 2017L,
  variable = c("v2017a", "v2017b"),
  label = c("Concept A", "Concept B"),
  name = c("conceptA", "conceptB"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
extendVarsPSID(vars, cwf)
#> $vars
#>   dataset year variable     label     name
#> 1     fam 2017   v2017a Concept A conceptA
#> 2     fam 2017   v2017b Concept B conceptB
#> 3     fam 2019   v2019a Concept A conceptA
#> 4     fam 2021   v2021a Concept A conceptA
#> 5     fam 2019   v2019b Concept B conceptB
#> 6     fam 2021   v2021b Concept B conceptB
#> 
#> $review
#>       name year variable anchor_year anchor_variable status
#> 1 conceptA 2019   v2019a        2017          v2017a  added
#> 2 conceptA 2021   v2021a        2017          v2017a  added
#> 3 conceptB 2019   v2019b        2017          v2017b  added
#> 4 conceptB 2021   v2021b        2017          v2017b  added
#>
